tr.title: Hakkımızda
tr.description: Gebze-Kocaeli merkezli Aydınox; paslanmaz çelik proses ekipmanları, mühendislik ve tesis kurulumunda uçtan uca çözüm sunar.

sections.heading: Biz Kimiz?
sections.body: Aydın Proses Makine Sanayi Ticaret Limited Şirketi (Aydınox), kimya, gıda, ilaç, kozmetik ve boya sektörlerine yönelik paslanmaz çelik proses ekipmanları üreten; mühendislik, tasarım, imalat, montaj, devreye alma ve servis faaliyetlerini tek çatı altında yürüten bir üretim ve proje firmasıdır.

sections.heading: Ne Yapıyoruz?
sections.body: Reaktörler, tanklar, silo sistemleri, ısı eşanjörleri, karıştırıcılar, filtreler, etüv hatları ve özel tasarım makineler imal ediyoruz. Proje tasarımından saha montajına ve otomasyona kadar tüm süreci müşterilerimizle birlikte planlıyoruz.

sections.heading: Hizmet Verdiğimiz Sektörler
sections.body: Gıda ve içecek, ilaç, kozmetik, kimya ve boya endüstrilerinde hijyenik ve proses güvenliği odaklı ekipmanlar sunuyoruz. Her proje için kapasite, akışkan özellikleri ve yerel mevzuat gereksinimleri dikkate alınır.

sections.heading: Neden Aydınox?
sections.body: Sahada kanıtlanmış referans projeler, TSE uyumlu üretim disiplini ve ISO yönetim sistemleriyle belgelenmiş süreçlerimiz; müşterilerimize güvenilir teslimat ve uzun ömürlü ekipman anlamına gelir. Teknik ekibimiz tekliften devreye almaya kadar yanınızda kalır.

en.title: About Us
en.description: Based in Gebze-Kocaeli, Aydınox delivers end-to-end stainless steel process equipment, engineering and plant installation.

sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.body: Aydın Process Machinery Industry and Trade Ltd. (Aydınox) manufactures stainless steel process equipment for chemical, food, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and paint industries, covering engineering, design, manufacturing, assembly, commissioning and service under one roof.

sections.heading: What We Do
sections.body: We build reactors, tanks, silo systems, heat exchangers, mixers, filters, oven lines and custom-designed machines. From project design to on-site assembly and automation, we plan the full journey with our customers.

sections.heading: Industries We Serve
sections.body: We supply hygienic, process-safe equipment for food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, chemical and paint industries. Capacity, fluid properties and local regulatory requirements are considered for every project.

sections.heading: Why Aydınox
sections.body: Proven reference projects, TSE-aligned manufacturing discipline and ISO-certified management systems mean reliable delivery and long-lasting equipment. Our technical team stays with you from quote to commissioning.

ar.title: من نحن
ar.description: أيدينوكس في غبزة-قوجا إيلي تقدم معدات عمليات من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ والهندسة وتركيب المنشآت بشكل متكامل.

sections.heading: من نحن؟
sections.body: شركة أيدين بروسيس ماشيني للصناعة والتجارة المحدودة (أيدينوكس) تصنع معدات عمليات من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ لقطاعات الكيماويات والغذاء والأدوية ومستحضرات التجميل والدهانات، وتغطي الهندسة والتصميم والتصنيع والتركيب والتشغيل والخدمة.

sections.heading: ماذا نقدم؟
sections.body: نصنع المفاعلات والخزانات وأنظمة الصوامع ومبادلات الحرارة والخلاطات والفلاتر وخطوط الأفران والآلات المصممة خصيصاً. نخطط المسار الكامل مع العملاء من التصميم إلى التركيب في الموقع والأتمتة.

sections.heading: القطاعات
sections.body: نورد معدات صحية وآمنة للعمليات في صناعات الغذاء والمشروبات والأدوية ومستحضرات التجميل والكيماويات والدهانات.

sections.heading: لماذا أيدينوكس؟
sections.body: مشاريع مرجعية مثبتة وانضباط إنتاج متوافق مع TSE وأنظمة إدارة معتمدة وفق ISO تعني تسليماً موثوقاً ومعدات طويلة العمر.

tr.title: Misyon & Vizyon
tr.description: Kalite, güvenlik, çevre ve müşteri memnuniyetini birlikte yöneten bir üretim kültürü.

sections.heading: Misyonumuz
sections.body: Müşterilerimizin proses ihtiyaçlarına uygun, güvenli ve verimli ekipmanlar tasarlayıp üretmek; montaj ve servisle yatırımların zamanında ve sürdürülebilir şekilde devreye alınmasını sağlamak.

sections.heading: Vizyonumuz
sections.body: Paslanmaz çelik proses ekipmanlarında Türkiye ve çevre bölgelerde ilk akla gelen, teknoloji ve mühendislik gücüyle fark yaratan bir marka olmak.

sections.heading: Değerlerimiz
sections.body: İş güvenliği, çevreye saygı, şeffaf iletişim, mühendislikte doğruluk ve müşteri odaklılık. Her projede kaliteyi ölçülebilir standartlarla takip ederiz.

sections.heading: Sürdürülebilirlik
sections.body: ISO 14001 ve ISO 45001 sistemleriyle çevresel etkiyi ve iş sağlığı güvenliğini yönetir; ISO 10002 ile müşteri geri bildirimlerini sürekli iyileştirme döngüsüne dahil ederiz.

en.title: Mission & Vision
en.description: A production culture that manages quality, safety, environment and customer satisfaction together.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: To design and manufacture safe, efficient equipment aligned with our customers' process needs, and to deliver and commission investments on time through assembly and service.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.body: To be the first brand that comes to mind in stainless steel process equipment in Turkey and neighbouring regions, standing out with engineering and technology strength.

sections.heading: Our Values
sections.body: Occupational safety, respect for the environment, transparent communication, engineering integrity and customer focus. We track quality with measurable standards on every project.

sections.heading: Sustainability
sections.body: We manage environmental impact and occupational health and safety through ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, and integrate customer feedback into continuous improvement through ISO 10002.

ar.title: الرسالة والرؤية
ar.description: ثقافة إنتاج تدير الجودة والسلامة والبيئة ورضا العملاء معاً.

sections.heading: رسالتنا
sections.body: تصميم وتصنيع معدات آمنة وفعالة وفق احتياجات عمليات العملاء، وضمان التشغيل في الوقت المناسب عبر التركيب والخدمة.

sections.heading: رؤيتنا
sections.body: أن نكون العلامة الأولى في معدات العمليات من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ في تركيا والمنطقة.

sections.heading: قيمنا
sections.body: سلامة العمل، احترام البيئة، تواصل شفاف، دقة هندسية وتركيز على العميل.

sections.heading: الاستدامة
sections.body: إدارة الأثر البيئي وسلامة العمل عبر ISO 14001 و ISO 45001، وتحسين مستمر عبر ISO 10002.

tr.title: Kalite Politikası
tr.description: Kanunlara, yasal düzenlemelere ve müşteri beklentilerine tam uyumlu kaliteli üretim.

sections.heading: Kalite Anlayışımız
sections.body: Kalite; yalnızca ürün kontrolü değil, tasarımdan montaja kadar tüm süreçlerde müşteri şartnamesine, yasal düzenlemelere ve iş güvenliği kurallarına uyumdur. Her aşamada kayıt altına alınan kontrollerle izlenebilir üretim yapılır.

sections.heading: TSE ve Sektörel Uyum
sections.body: TSE standartları ve sektörel hijyen gereksinimleri temel referansımızdır. Gıda, ilaç, kozmetik ve kimya projelerinde malzeme seçimi, yüzey işlemi ve kaynak kalitesi proses risklerine göre belirlenir.

sections.heading: Entegre Yönetim Sistemleri
sections.body: ISO 9001 kalite, ISO 14001 çevre, ISO 45001 iş sağlığı ve güvenliği ile ISO 10002 müşteri memnuniyeti sertifikalarımız DSR Belgelendirme denetimleriyle yürütülür. Sertifikalarımız Belgeler sayfasında ayrı ayrı yayınlanmaktadır.

sections.heading: Sürekli İyileştirme
sections.body: İç denetimler, müşteri geri bildirimleri ve saha servis kayıtları iyileştirme planlarımızın girdisidir. Hedefimiz; daha güvenli üretim, daha az çevresel etki ve daha yüksek müşteri memnuniyeti.

en.title: Quality Policy
en.description: Quality production fully compliant with laws, regulations and customer expectations.

sections.heading: Our Quality Approach
sections.body: Quality is not only final inspection but compliance with customer specifications, regulations and safety rules from design to assembly. Production is traceable through documented controls at every stage.

sections.heading: TSE and Industry Compliance
sections.body: TSE standards and industry hygiene requirements are our baseline. Material selection, surface finish and weld quality are defined according to process risks in food, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and chemical projects.

sections.heading: Integrated Management Systems
sections.body: Our ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 10002 certificates are maintained through DSR Certification audits. Each certificate is published separately on the Certificates page.

sections.heading: Continuous Improvement
sections.body: Internal audits, customer feedback and field service records feed our improvement plans. We aim for safer production, lower environmental impact and higher customer satisfaction.

ar.title: سياسة الجودة
ar.description: إنتاج عالي الجودة متوافق مع القوانين واللوائح وتوقعات العملاء.

sections.heading: نهج الجودة
sections.body: الجودة هي الامتثال للمواصفات واللوائح وقواعد السلامة من التصميم إلى التركيب.

sections.heading: TSE والامتثال القطاعي
sections.body: معايير TSE ومتطلبات النظافة الصناعية هي مرجعنا الأساسي.

sections.heading: أنظمة الإدارة المتكاملة
sections.body: شهادات ISO 9001 و14001 و45001 و10002 تُدار عبر تدقيقات DSR ومنشورة في صفحة الشهادات.

sections.heading: التحسين المستمر
sections.body: التدقيق الداخلي وملاحظات العملاء وسجلات الخدمة تغذي خطط التحسين.

sections.heading: Belgelendirme Kuruluşu
sections.body: Sertifikalar DSR Certification and Inspection, LLC tarafından düzenlenmiş ve denetlenmektedir. Sertifika numaraları ve geçerlilik tarihleri her kartın altında belirtilmiştir.

sections.body: Montaj kılavuzları, P&ID ve proje dosyaları proje bazında hazırlanır. Talep halinde müşterilerimizle paylaşılır.

sections.heading: Certificate Scope
sections.body: Engineering, design, manufacturing, assembly, commissioning and service of stainless steel process equipment, reactors, tanks, silo systems, heat exchangers and custom-designed machines for chemical, food, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and paint industries.

sections.heading: Certification Body
sections.body: Certificates are issued and audited by DSR Certification and Inspection, LLC. Certificate numbers and validity dates are shown on each card.

sections.body: Assembly manuals, P&IDs and project files are prepared per project and shared with customers on request.

sections.body: الهندسة والتصميم والتصنيع والتركيب والتشغيل والخدمة لمعدات العمليات من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ للقطاعات الكيميائية والغذائية والدوائية ومستحضرات التجميل والدهانات.

sections.heading: جهة الاعتماد
sections.body: الشهادات صادرة عن DSR Certification and Inspection, LLC.

sections.heading: الوثائق الفنية
sections.body: أدلة التركيب ومخططات العمليات تُعد لكل مشروع عند الطلب.

sections.heading: Ekibimize Katılın
sections.body: Üretim, proje mühendisliği, montaj, satış ve operasyon alanlarında deneyimli veya kariyer hedefleyen adayları ekibimize dahil etmekten memnuniyet duyarız.

en.title: Privacy Notice (KVKK)
en.description: Notice under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 on data processing activities.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body:
Under Article 10 of Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK), your personal data is processed by Aydınox Process Machinery as data controller.

Address: Balçık Mah. Mustafa Kemal Cad. Çam Sokak No: 5, Gebze-Kocaeli
Email: info@aydinox.com.tr
Phone: +90 262 751 43 07

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: This notice covers website visitors, people who submit quote or contact forms, those who reach us by phone or email, and candidates who send a CV via Human Resources.

sections.heading: 3. Personal data processed
sections.body:
Identity: name.
Contact: phone, email.
Customer transaction: company name, request type, product/service group.
Project: city, project details, free-text notes.
Careers: CV and information shared in email.
Transaction security: IP address, form submit time, privacy consent record.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes of processing
sections.body: Preparing quotes; running production, assembly and engineering processes; client relations and complaints; assessing job applications; meeting legal duties; keeping the site secure.

sections.heading: 5. Legal bases
sections.body: Processing is based on contract formation or performance, legal obligation, legitimate interest and explicit consent under KVKK Art. 5.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body:
Under KVKK Art. 11 you may learn whether your data is processed, request information, correction, deletion and compensation for damage.

You may submit requests to info@aydinox.com.tr.
